title: Throws an error in no-shadow-restricted-names when enabled modules

labels.name: accepted
labels.description: There is consensus among the team that this change meets the criteria for inclusion

labels.name: archived due to age
labels.description: This issue has been archived; please open a new issue for any further discussion

body:
I bumped a following error with enabled modules option.

``` sh
$ cat module.js
export default function () {
}
```

``` sh
$ cat .eslintrc
{
  "ecmaFeatures": {
    "modules": true
  }
}
```

``` sh
$ ./node_modules/.bin/eslint module.js

/Users/okuryu/work/test-eslint/node_modules/eslint/lib/rules/no-shadow-restricted-names.js:17
        if (RESTRICTED.indexOf(id.name) > -1) {
                                 ^
TypeError: Cannot read property 'name' of null
    at checkForViolation (/Users/okuryu/work/test-eslint/node_modules/eslint/lib/rules/no-shadow-restricted-names.js:17:34)
    at EventEmitter.FunctionDeclaration (/Users/okuryu/work/test-eslint/node_modules/eslint/lib/rules/no-shadow-restricted-names.js:39:13)
    at EventEmitter.emit (events.js:117:20)
    at Controller.controller.traverse.enter (/Users/okuryu/work/test-eslint/node_modules/eslint/lib/eslint.js:726:25)
    at Controller.__execute (/Users/okuryu/work/test-eslint/node_modules/eslint/node_modules/estraverse/estraverse.js:399:31)
    at Controller.traverse (/Users/okuryu/work/test-eslint/node_modules/eslint/node_modules/estraverse/estraverse.js:497:28)
    at EventEmitter.module.exports.api.verify (/Users/okuryu/work/test-eslint/node_modules/eslint/lib/eslint.js:719:24)
    at processFile (/Users/okuryu/work/test-eslint/node_modules/eslint/lib/cli-engine.js:193:27)

    at walk (/Users/okuryu/work/test-eslint/node_modules/eslint/lib/util/traverse.js:81:9)
```

``` sh
$ ./node_modules/.bin/eslint -v
v0.16.1
```
